description: This Java class acts as a command handler for adding a client collateral product within the Fineract platform. It processes commands of type 'CREATE' related to client collateral products by delegating the operation to the corresponding service.

classes.name: AddClientCollateralProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service that handles commands to create a new client collateral product by invoking the relevant service method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to add a client collateral product, passing the JsonCommand to the service layer and returning the result.
